title: Pluto-Charon dynamical-spectrum row
description: One row in Pluto-Charon's per-body action-angle decomposition. Single row_type catalogue ('dynamical_mode'); each row records one frequency mode in the binary's dynamical state — the TRIPLE 1:1 lock angles (mutual orbital sidereal motion + Pluto spin + Charon spin, all at 6.387230 d), the apsidal-libration mode, four action variables (eccentricity / mutual obliquity / Charon-Pluto mass ratio / heliocentric inclination), and four small-moon near-commensurability angles (Styx ≈ 3 × P_orb, Nix ≈ 4 × P_orb, Kerberos ≈ 5 × P_orb, Hydra ≈ 6 × P_orb).

frequency_per_century.description: Mode frequency in cycles per century. 0.0 indicates a pure-action row (eccentricity / mutual obliquity / mass-ratio / heliocentric-inclination).

period_days.description: Equivalent period in days for cycle-class modes; +inf for pure-action rows (the JSON encoding writes pure-action periods as Infinity).

amplitude_value.description: Characteristic amplitude of the mode in source-units (see amplitude_units).

amplitude_units.description: Units of amplitude_value: 'rad' for the locked-angle modes (2π); 'deg' for mutual-obliquity / heliocentric-inclination; 'ratio' for small-moon near-commensurability ratios; 'dimensionless' for eccentricity / mass-ratio actions.

angle_or_action.description: Whether the mode is an angle variable (lives on a torus, periodic mod 2π) or an action variable (slowly varying real interval).

precision_flag.description: Per-§17.1.6 ship-readiness convention. 'high' = post-New-Horizons published precision; 'medium' for the small-moon Styx near-3:1 (5% off, the loosest commensurability); 'low' for the apsidal-libration mode (largely a mathematical construct given the e ~ 5e-5 amplitude).

notes.description: Per-row free-text notes — physical interpretation, cross-references to v0.21.6 tidal-migration / v0.23.0 spin-orbit-resonance / v0.24.x companion catalogues.

source_doi.description: DOI of the peer-reviewed paper authorising this row's numerical values. All Pluto-Charon row sources are real Crossref-indexed papers (Brozovic 2015, Stern 1992 / 2015, Showalter-Hamilton 2015) — no nodoi: / historical: / isbn: prefixes.

source_published_date.description: ISO 8601 partial date for the cited source.

entered_locally_at.description: ISO 8601 date when this row was added to the AMSC catalogue.

source_version.description: Optional. For mission/dataset release tags (e.g., 'New Horizons') when applicable.
